topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: The world tilts when I find the pages, hidden beneath the old, worn books. Words spill across the paper, a labyrinth leading back to me. Each line, a thread of something I can't quite grasp, yet it clings to my thoughts, winding tighter. I move through the shadows of the room, the air thick with unsaid words. The scent of ink and paper mingles with the familiar, the comfort now tinged with something undefined. I trace the edges of the pages, each one a whisper of secrets I didn’t know we kept. The silence is a heavy cloak, and I shrink into it, waiting for the storm to come.
